name: Classic Crunch
description: The distortion half way, the filter a little closed: the gritty crunch of a late-seventies rock rhythm.

name: Dark Lead
description: Full distortion with the filter well closed: a smooth, dark lead that sustains.

name: Edge of Breakup
description: The distortion low: a mild, open overdrive that pushes an amplifier.

name: Fuzzed Bass
description: On a bass at full quality: grit on the notes, the filter keeping the top civil.

name: Grunge Wall
description: Most of the distortion, the filter open: thick, raw and loud.
